stages.name: base
stages.text:
Build a CSV cleaner.
Input (stdin, one JSON object): {"csv": string}. Records are separated by 
 or 
. Fields are separated by commas. A field that starts with a double quote is quoted: it runs to the matching closing quote, may contain commas and line breaks, and "" inside it stands for one ". Every opening quote has a matching closing quote, and a closing quote is always followed by a comma, a line break or the end of the input. Unquoted fields have leading and trailing spaces (U+0020 only) removed; quoted fields are kept exactly. A lone  that is not followed by 
 is ordinary data. A line holding only spaces is a record, not an empty line. The first record is the header. Records that are empty lines are skipped. A data record whose field count differs from the header's is rejected.
Output (stdout, one JSON object): {"rows": [{header: value string, ...}, ...] in input order, "errors": [int, ...]} where errors lists, in order, the 1-based physical line number on which each rejected record starts.

stages.name: cr1
stages.text: Change request 1: the input may carry an optional field "types": {column: "int" | "bool"}. In that column, "int" values must match an optional '-' followed by one or more digits and become JSON integers; "bool" values must be exactly true or false (lower case) and become JSON booleans. A row with any value that fails its conversion is rejected and its start line is added to errors. Every column named in "types" is a header column.

stages.name: cr2
stages.text: Change request 2: the input may carry an optional field "dedupe_on": [column, ...]. Among accepted rows, a row whose values in those columns (after type conversion) equal those of an earlier accepted row is dropped. The output gains "duplicates": int, the number of dropped rows (0 when dedupe_on is absent or empty; an empty list dedupes nothing). Every column named in "dedupe_on" is a header column.

reqs.text: quoted fields: commas, line breaks, doubled quotes; kept exactly
unquoted fields trimmed; empty lines skipped; \r\n accepted
wrong field count rejected; errors = physical start line numbers
int/bool typed columns converted; failed conversion rejects the row
dedupe keeps first accepted row per key; duplicates count, 0 when absent

mutants.m2: errors report record index instead of physical line
mutants.m3: dedupe keeps the last row instead of the first
